conbody.p: The rear view while driving helps you drive more safely by checking the rear view with a monitor even while driving.

li.p: Press the parking/view button (1) at D (Drive) or N (Neutral) to turn on the video.
The rear view function while driving is released when one of the following conditions is satisfied.
Press the parking/view button (1) or the infotainment system operation button (4).
